integrity: The analytical comparison proof and finite exact-arithmetic sample certificate were examined together; numerical checks are not substitutes for infinite-time proofs. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The half-line unbounded infectivity variable is a mathematical rate-trait extension, not a physical probability; the zero-susceptible limit can require arbitrarily long times and does not describe finite populations. The finite cap result holds for reflecting conservative mutation. A related heterogeneous-SEIR paper was accessible only via a publisher preview, leaving a documented comparison risk.
title: Unbounded mutation erases the final susceptible fraction in an evolutionary SIR equation
